newsitem.title: ITALY: World Bank issues zero-coupon 10-yr bond - BNL.
newsitem.headline: World Bank issues zero-coupon 10-yr bond - BNL.

text.p: The World Bank is launching a zero-coupon 10-year bond with a nominal value of 1.0 trillion lire on the domestic market, lead manager Banca Nazionale del Lavoro (BNL) said in a statement.
BNL said the operation represented the most significant bond issue on the World Bank on the domestic Italian market.
BNL said the subscription price would be announced on January 17 and the bond would be tradeable in minimum blocks of a nominal value of five million lire.
It would be offered to the public by BNL and other banks participating in a consortium to place the bond, on January 20 and 21, with payment on January 31.
The issue was part of a strategy to widen the base of investors, BNL said.
